notes.title: Soundtrack is now available!
notes.content:
We have heard your feedback, and are therefore happy to announce that the soundtrack for Miko Gakkou: Second Year is [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/432650?beta=0]now available[/url] for download in high quality DRM-free MP3 files as DLC! 

Get it now with the initial 20% launch discount!

notes.title: A new winter adventure is about to start
notes.content:
We would like to announce that winter recess is about to start at Ayanoyama Miko Gakkou, and with it a completely new adventure, this time in 3D!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/332370]Miko Gakkou Monogatari: Kaede Episode[/url] will be available on Steam, starting on November 27 at 10 PM PST.

To celebrate the launch of our new game, Miko Gakkou: Second year will have a special two-week discount so you can save when getting both games!

Thank you very much for your patience, and let's mikomiko this winter!

notes.title: Autumn message for prospective students
notes.content:
We would like to announce that the student council at Ayanoyama Miko Gakkou has decided to join Steam's Autumn Sale.

Starting today, and for a limited time, you can join our school with a special Autumn discount of 10% over the admissions fee. This covers tuition and boarding.

Please notice that this offer is for a limited time only, so do take this chance to join our school and help us fight those mischievous youkai.

Translation: Our game is currently 10% off for a limited time.

notes.title: If you're playing with a game controller...
notes.content:
You may find it useful to know that you can move left and right using the shoulder buttons on a game controller.

In our experience, using the shoulder buttons is more pleasant than the thumbstick.

Let us know if you have other hints!

notes.title: Welcome to Miko Gakkou
notes.content:
On behalf of all of the members of the Ayanoyama Miko Gakkou student council, I welcome you all to the Steam campus of Miko Gakkou.

Today marks the beginning of a new era. An era where humans and youkai can coexist peacefully and harmoniously. We are counting on you to help us keep the balance between the worlds of human and youkai, and put in place those youkai who, by their mischief cause trouble to other humans.

To celebrate the launch of our Steam campus, we will be offering a discount of 10% over the school fees to those who choose to join us during our first week.

Thank you very much for believing in us, and we're looking forward to seeing you in school.

Translation: This game has a launch discount of 10% during the first week.
